chung.Syllabus Name: Mô hình và mô phỏng_Modeling and Simulation for Automotive Systems
chung.Course Name English: Modeling and Simulation for Automotive Systems
chung.Learning-Teaching Method: In-class lecture, Inquiry-based Teaching, Design Thinking
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description:
The module equips you with knowledge on how to simulate and model elements in the automotive industry. In this course, students will learn about building digital models to simulate and test various elements of the automotive development process.

This course provides fundamental concepts and practical techniques of modeling and simulation in the context of digital automotive systems. Students will learn to develop and analyze digital models to simulate vehicle subsystems, embedded software behavior, and automotive development processes, supporting design validation, system integration, and performance optimization in software-defined vehicles.

clo: Have knowledge of fundamentals, mathematical descriptions, and simulation goals for automobile dynamics

Focusing on the essential tools for mechanics, details vectors and second-order tensors, the method of multibody systems to describe vehicle dynamics, focusing here on open and closed kinematic chains
Students will learn about the vehicle body serves as the reference body for other components like the drivetrain and suspension
Introduce Kinematics and Dynamics of the Vehicle Body, Force Components, Single Track Models, Twin Track Models,Three-Dimensional Complete Vehicle Models, Model of a Typical Complex Complete Vehicle
Ability to Modeling and Analysis of Wheel Suspensions, the Road-Tire-Contact, the Drivetrain
Utilize engineering software tools to Modeling and Simulation for Automotive Systems
